name: PR Review and Draft
description: Review code changes for correctness, performance, security, and test completeness, then draft a structured PR summary.

operational.approval_boundary: Safe for review and drafting; require human approval before applying code changes based on review findings.
operational.use_when: Use when code changes need correctness, performance, security, and test review plus a structured PR draft.

limitations: Instruction package only; it does not provide or authorize an executable runtime capability.
usability.quickstart: Read SKILL.md and follow the documented workflow.
